scope: Synthetic React workspace with real offline Python HTTP handler and Strands sessions. Cloud deployment and practising-user acceptance require separate evidence.

aws_release.observed_result_evidence: NOT_RUN: parent owns release publication and AWS verification. The CI results below do not assert that the React build is live at this URL.

cases.requirement: Supply a take or release through accessible forms and recover it after reload.
cases.preconditions: Fresh session; fictional shoot day; Python API reachable.
steps: Submit malformed JSON and a missing-field document
Fill synthetic take fields and save
Reload and inspect slate and source report
cases.expected_outcome: Invalid data is refused with entries kept; valid take persists; duplicate does not create a second take.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Server error keeps the form and offers a saved-state reload.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: desktop and mobile LT01 submitted invalid/incomplete documents, saved a synthetic take, reloaded it and rejected a duplicate; API scene contained 41 takes. Form-retention component tests passed. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Decisions apply only to reviewed evidence; later evidence requires new decisions.
steps: Accept continuity with name and reason
cases.expected_outcome: Old digest cannot approve new evidence; withdrawal survives reload; new explicit decision is recorded.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Posting the earlier finding digest receives 409.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: desktop and mobile LT02 recorded a decision, added evidence, observed withdrawal across reload, and recorded a fresh decision. Python regression rejected the earlier digest with 409. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Resume a saved Strands approval, act once on retry, publish a sealed turnover and portable role receipt.
cases.preconditions: Checkpoint has raised a pickup interrupt.
steps: Approve pickup and repeat exact API request
cases.expected_outcome: One pickup event; separate wrap approval; saved turnover and receipt carry run, policy, digests and open items.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Other roles cannot approve; accepted exceptions remain visible.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: desktop and mobile LT03 resumed the saved Strands pickup interrupt, confirmed exactly one pickup event after retry, supplied evidence, recorded role decisions, obtained separate wrap approval, published/reloaded turnover and downloaded a sealed receipt with remaining open items. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Untrusted caller prose cannot become a sealed subject assertion.
steps: Request receipt with unknown subject keys
cases.expected_outcome: Invalid subjects are 400; only the existing beat identifier enters the receipt; no approval inferred.
cases.negative_recovery_case: String, nested array and extra assertion keys are refused.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: Python parameterized regressions rejected unchecked subject types, extra assertions and nonexistent beat identifiers; existing B-17 was accepted without inferred approval. Both real-HTTP LT03 journeys rejected caller_assertion with 400. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Deep links and saved runs preserve safe session ownership.
cases.expected_outcome: Only owned runs are listed; foreign requests denied; late old responses cannot change the selected run.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Missing session handle receives 403; selected-run mismatch blocks mutation.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: Python verified owned-run recovery and foreign-session denial. RTL regressions discarded a late old-run response during navigation and prevented a stale action callback from sending an approval. Browser journeys verified reload and hash navigation; the pending-refresh race is component-tested, not browser fault-injected. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Bounded waits and storage-denied recovery remain usable.
cases.preconditions: Browser storage denied or API stalls.
steps: Create run in the active tab
Read error and refresh saved state
cases.expected_outcome: No white screen; tab-held session works with clear limitation; timeout does not automatically retry a write.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Expired or unavailable session can be replaced explicitly.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATION PASS: both real-HTTP browser projects created a usable tab-held session with browser storage denied. Fake-timer unit regression verified one write attempt aborted after 35 seconds. RTL verified explicit recovery from a session-loading failure. A real network outage was not staged. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Readable script and actionable controls across desktop and mobile.
cases.expected_outcome: Semantic controls, visible focus, useful first viewport, responsive single-column script on narrow screens.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Search with no match explains the empty state.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATED CHECKS PASS: Chromium desktop 1440px and mobile 390px journeys used labelled controls and checked no horizontal overflow; component tests exercised empty search and evidence inspection. Screenshots are in the evidence artifact. Manual keyboard, assistive-technology and physical-device acceptance remain NOT_RUN. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.

cases.requirement: Synthetic data and actual providers are labelled truthfully.
cases.expected_outcome: Real Strands SDK identified; offline scripted planner and API-reported lexical interpreter identified; no Bedrock execution implied.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Unassessed evidence is never displayed as verified.
cases.observed_result_evidence: AUTOMATED CHECKS PASS: component/app tests exercised synthetic guided mode, execution labels including offline-lexical/1.0.0, unchecked evidence and receipt limitations. Build contract rejected HTML proxies. Cloud runtime provider verification and evaluator signoff remain NOT_RUN. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/lasttake-aws/actions/runs/34326031169; frontend-evidence-4953c125e499d40f6ce13c0eeff42d92d726322a.
